[SERVICE DOMAIN: Open Item Management] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Operational Services (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain provides a service for handling the resolution of open items again st accounts (such as overdue loan payments)
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Process Asset Type : Open Item Generic Artifact : Procedure Control Record : Open Item Procedure
ESTRUCTURA DEL CONTROL RECORD (Open Item Procedure Instance Record, 8 atributos) Open Item Type | Open Item Description | Product Instance Reference | Party Reference | Loan Repayment Schedule | Loan Outstanding Balance | Loan Termination Date | Repayment Statement
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (2) Tracking (6 atributos) Repayment (7 atributos)
INTERFAZ Y COMPORTAMIENTO OPERATIVO Action Terms : Control Request Retrieve Update Initiate Exchange Execute Inbound service operations : 11 Outbound service events : 6
Que Action Term activa que Behavior Qualifier: Control Record <- Control, Request, Retrieve, Update, Initiate BQ Tracking <- Retrieve BQ Repayment <- Update, Exchange, Execute, Retrieve, Initiate
